slices.title: Negotiate and retire a peer
slices.workflow: Create a configured peer, negotiate byte-safe SDP/ICE, restart or roll back, and consume bounded terminal outcomes after close and actor migration.

slices.title: Exchange and close a data channel
slices.workflow: Configure/open a channel, exchange ordered and unreliable messages, observe readiness/buffering/native outcomes, then close from a migrated session.

slices.title: Install sender RTP parameters safely
slices.workflow: Read a fresh transaction, install native-supported sender/initial encoding parameters, and observe correct effective behavior across multiple senders.

slices.title: Observe and control RTP endpoints
slices.workflow: Use native sender/receiver/transceiver controls, DTMF, source/capability queries and first-packet observations on a live call.

slices.title: Inspect and operate a retained transport
slices.workflow: Obtain RTP/SCTP/DTLS/ICE handles, perform supported transport operations and observe native state through teardown.

slices.title: Send and receive PCM audio
slices.workflow: Create/configure PCM audio source, track and sink, exchange real audio, and reconfigure/retire them through public peer and actor APIs.

slices.title: Send and receive raw video
slices.workflow: Create a raw-frame source and sink, publish/receive decoded video and replace inputs without breaking peer ownership.

slices.title: Use selected video codec products
slices.workflow: Discover/query/create full-value video codecs and selectors, then select/replace the actual installed product for a sender.

slices.title: Publish and receive encoded Opus
slices.workflow: Publish caller-provided Opus access units on a real call with per-unit audio metadata and protected-byte fidelity.

slices.title: Publish concurrent encoded video profiles
slices.workflow: One peer carries concurrent native-supported compressed-video sources and profiles, preserving independent initialization, rate guidance and metadata.
owned_files: slice-owned new encoded-video modules after seam extraction

slices.title: Replace and retire sources independently
slices.workflow: Replace/reconfigure one source while others keep sending, then consume bounded control outcomes and retire individual source resources.

slices.title: Transform live encoded frames safely
slices.workflow: Install caller transformer/completions on actual sender and receiver paths and deliver/return retained native frames.

slices.title: Encrypt and decrypt frames through public endpoints
slices.workflow: Create/install caller crypto resources, observe getter identity and exchange frames with truthful SFrame behavior.

slices.title: Use owning audio factory and codec products
slices.workflow: An application queries/creates and uses owning native or caller audio products/frames with exact contexts and failures outside peer installation.
owned_files: src/audio_codec_values.rs (factory/product value sections only; exclude S09 producer-format sections; explicit lease)
src/audio_encoder.rs (standalone factory/product facade sections only; exclude S18 stock ANA/control sections; explicit lease)

slices.title: Select a caller audio factory in a live call
slices.workflow: Install a caller factory through public peer/session construction and negotiate/create a real selected audio codec safely.

slices.title: Encode caller audio in the real send path
slices.workflow: Install a caller-defined encoder product and encode valid send input with real output/failure behavior.

slices.title: Decode caller frames in the real receive path
slices.workflow: Install a caller-defined modern decoder/frame product with safe generic capacities and truthful internal compatibility.

slices.title: Use stock encoder controls and safely enable ANA
slices.workflow: Configure a real stock encoder, enable an admitted ANA configuration and observe actual native adaptation/control/lifecycle behavior.

slices.title: Drive an owning standalone NetEq
slices.workflow: Create a standalone native/caller NetEq, register supported codecs, feed packets and consume audio/metadata with safe retention and failures.

slices.title: Run with a caller-owned execution environment
slices.workflow: Select clocks, field trials, queues/metronomes and retained resources through real creation APIs while preserving production and controlled semantics.

slices.title: Create a peer with selected network/security providers
slices.workflow: Select network manager/socket/DNS/TLS/permission/certificate providers and observe their actual native calls during peer setup and transport use.

slices.title: Record events through an installed caller log
slices.workflow: Select an event-log factory/output through real environment/peer/session creation, receive owning native event/RTP values and retire safely.

slices.title: Adapt a live call with selected congestion/FEC providers
slices.workflow: Install network controller/predictor/FEC/bitrate components and observe actual feedback/rate/protection callbacks on a call.

slices.title: Use selected audio processing and device components
slices.workflow: Configure actual audio processing/builders/mixers/frame processors and optional Linux audio devices through public call creation.

slices.title: Use selected Linux capture and video sources
slices.workflow: Discover/select optional camera or screen capture, deliver frames to public sources/sinks and retire capture safely through actor paths.

slices.title: Drive and replay a controlled peer world
slices.workflow: A caller owns one single-thread world, advances bounded logical time and external packet decisions, and deterministically retires queued work.

slices.title: Replay impaired mixed media in a controlled world
slices.workflow: Run real bidirectional prerecorded media and mixed/replaced encoded sources under externally chosen loss/reorder/duplication with deterministic output.

slices.title: Build and consume matched Linux SDK artifacts
slices.workflow: Build core/native Linux packages with required real implementations and consume them through Rust and SDK/native companion programs.
